notes: Napoleon documentary, chapter 2 (Corsica and the Revolution): 7 paintings x 4 seeds, 16:9, style ghm_painterly_v2. Client picks; nothing is final before approval.

shots.framing: wide view of a small Mediterranean harbour town from the water, fishing boats in the foreground, a citadel on the point, tall shuttered houses, mountains behind
shots.scene: Ajaccio, Corsica, in the 1770s, Genoese citadel, lateen-sailed fishing boats, maquis-covered mountains, a few fishermen mending nets
shots.lighting: warm late-afternoon Mediterranean sun, clear air, soft blue shadows

shots.framing: medium-wide interior, a thin dark-haired boy of about twelve reading alone at a window seat on the left, a group of laughing cadets in blue uniforms on the right
shots.scene: the royal military school at Brienne, France, about 1781, a stone classroom with maps and globes, the Corsican boy Napoleone in a cadet's blue coat with a book of history
shots.lighting: cool daylight from a tall window falling on the boy, the rest of the room in soft shadow
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, adult face on the boy, bicorne, adult uniform

shots.framing: medium shot, a very young lean officer standing beside a bronze field gun on the left third, three-quarter view, gunners behind
shots.scene: Lieutenant Bonaparte of the La Fere artillery regiment, 1785, aged sixteen, blue artillery coat with red facings, artillery park at Valence

shots.framing: wide street-level view of a crowded Paris square, tricolour flags and banners above a dense crowd, a stone palace facade behind
shots.scene: Paris during the Revolution, 1792, crowds of sans-culottes with pikes and red caps, National Guards in blue, tricolour cockades, the Tuileries palace
shots.lighting: hazy summer afternoon light, smoke drifting over the square

shots.framing: wide night shot from behind an earthwork gun battery on a hill, gunners firing on the left, a young captain pointing toward the harbour, ships and forts below
shots.scene: the siege of Toulon, December 1793, Captain Bonaparte directing a French battery, British warships in the harbour, a burning fort across the water
shots.lighting: night, orange muzzle flashes and firelight, cold blue moonlight on the water

shots.framing: wide street view looking along a narrow Paris street toward the steps of a baroque church, government cannon firing in the foreground, insurgents scattering on the steps
shots.scene: Paris, 5 October 1795 (13 Vendemiaire), republican artillery on the rue Saint-Honore firing on royalist insurgents before the church of Saint-Roch
shots.lighting: grey autumn afternoon, gun smoke filling the street
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: medium shot in an elegant salon, a graceful woman of about thirty in a white high-waisted muslin gown seated on the left third, candles and mirrors
shots.scene: Josephine de Beauharnais in a Paris salon, 1796, dark curled hair, a cashmere shawl, Directoire furniture, guests in the background
shots.lighting: warm candlelight with soft reflections in tall mirrors
